title: Toronto neighbourhoods
description: Six Toronto neighbourhoods as the first country's zones: Cabbagetown, High Park, Kensington Market, the Distillery District, Yonge Street and The Beaches, each a walk screen with new skyline art and scrolling roadside props.

title: Card cue
description: Three replacements for the "!" over obstacles that open a card: a pulsing ground ring, a bright outline and a bobbing card-icon bubble, each on a walk screen at near, mid and far depths, with every zone road and the reduced-motion forms.
